text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is the last day of summer
camp.
Nakayama Festa and I are looking
over my plans
for after we've returned to
the academy when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...It's Coach—Teach's dad...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hello?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
Festa. How are you? Are you making
sure to eat
properly?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching your races. You're
already in
the homestretch of the Classic
Triple Crown, huh?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
My daughter's watching you too. She's
pestering
me every weekend about this
and that race
you've got coming up.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
The only time she ever smiles these days
is when
she's watching your races.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Coach?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
If possible, it'd be great if you could
meet once
more when she's out of the
hospital.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What?! She's getting let out?! Does that
mean—

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
It might be the last time you'll get, so
take your
time and tell her everything
you've been up to.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Okay... Um...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hold up. You don't actually mean...
Um...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's still a chance she can recover,
isn't there?
She hasn't just given up,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Coach, answer me. She still has time. She
still has
hope, right?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, Festa. I'm actually getting
ready to
meet with her doctor. I'll pass it
on to her that
you're doing well.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Frickin' hell.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm going to enter the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a hardened face and a warrior's
resolve,
Nakayama Festa boldly declares
her goal while
concealing the flicker of
worry in her eyes.
